cta.description: Extensions: shopify catalog extension active — responses may carry shop-specific enrichment beyond the core spec; `variants[*].url` is the PDP and `variants[*].checkout_url` is the buy-now target; discount extension advertised — cart/checkout may accept `discount_codes[]` and surface `discount_allocations` per line item; run --input-schema before adding discount fields; fulfillment extension advertised — delivery groups may carry richer scheduling/handle metadata than the core spec requires; run --input-schema before adding fulfillment fields. Cross-business results — each variant belongs to its own seller. Pick the seller AND variant the buyer wants (products[N].variants[M]) before proceeding. To create a cart, pass --business=<products[N].variants[M].seller.domain>. If chosen items span multiple seller.domain values, create one cart/checkout per seller. Buyer handoff: open products[N].variants[M].checkout_url for buy-now handoff when the buyer wants business-hosted checkout. More results available; paginate only if you need them.

Description Waveshare 7.5" E-Paper (B) E-Ink Raw Display, 800×480, Red/Black/White, SPI, w/o PCB Offers paper-like viewing experience Supports red, black, and white colors Reflects ambient light, needs no backlight Integrates with Raspberry Pi/Arduino Ultra-low power, retains content when off The Waveshare 7.5" E-Paper (B) E-Ink Raw Display, 800×480, Red/Black/White, SPI, w/o PCB is an advanced display solution that offers a paper-like viewing experience. This display features a resolution of 800×480 pixels and supports three colors: red, black, and white. It operates using a SPI interface and is designed without a printed circuit board, making it suitable for integration into various projects. This e-paper display is characterized by its low power consumption, as it only requires power during the refreshing process. It maintains the last displayed content even when powered down, thanks to its passive reflective display type. The display is ideal for applications such as price tags, shelf labels, and industrial instruments, where a wide viewing angle of over 170 degrees is beneficial. The display utilizes microcapsule electrophoretic technology, which allows it to reflect ambient light, similar to traditional printed paper. This technology ensures clear visibility under both natural and artificial lighting conditions, without the need for a backlight. The display supports partial refresh, allowing for quick updates in black and white. Development resources and manuals are available, providing examples for integration with platforms such as Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano, Arduino, and STM32. This makes the display a versatile choice for developers seeking to incorporate e-paper technology into their projects. Description 7.5in e-Paper (G) E-Ink Fully Laminated Display, Black/White, SPI w/o PCB Offers 7.5-inch e-Paper display Features a resolution of 800 x 480 pixel Comes with development resources and manual Keeps displaying the last content till power down Ultra-low power consumption The 7.5in e-Paper (G) E-Ink Fully Laminated Display, 800x480, Black/White, SPI w/o PCB comes with development resources and manual (driver board schematic, examples for Raspberry Pi/Jetson Nano/Arduino/STM32). Ultra-low power consumption, basically power is only required for refreshing. No backlight keeps displaying the last content for a long time even when power is down. Ideal for price tags, shelf labels, industrial instruments E-paper display utilizes microcapsule electrophoretic technology for displaying, the principle is - charged particles suspended in the clear fluid will move to the sides of the microcapsule when an electric field is applied, making the microcapsule become visible by reflecting ambient light, just as traditional printed paper. E-paper display will clearly display images/texts under lamplight or natural light requires no backlight and features nearly up to 180° viewing angle. It is usually used as an e-reader due to its paper-like effect.
